title: CasinoCore
description: Advanced GUI Minigame System for Minecraft
body:
# CasinoCore

CasinoCore is a modern, fully GUI-driven casino and arcade minigame system for Minecraft servers, built to provide fast, immersive, and highly configurable gameplay experiences.

Designed with performance, flexibility, and user experience in mind, CasinoCore allows server owners to introduce interactive chance-based games that integrate seamlessly into survival, economy, and community-focused servers.

---

## ⚙️ Dependencies

### REQUIRED

**Vault**  
Provides economy and permission system integration.  
https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/

**Economy Plugin (Vault-compatible)**  
CasinoCore does not include its own economy system. You must install a Vault-compatible economy plugin such as:
- EssentialsX Economy (recommended)
- Any other Vault-compatible economy plugin

---

### OPTIONAL (Soft Dependency)

**PlaceholderAPI**  
Enables expanded placeholder support for GUI and messages.  
https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/

**Citizens**  
Required for advanced NPC functionality, including custom NPC creation, skins, and interaction systems.  
https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/citizens.13811/

---

## ✨ Features

- Fully GUI-based gameplay system
- Interactive casino and arcade-style minigames
- Smooth and responsive animations
- Modern and intuitive user interface
- Highly configurable rewards and balancing
- Modular architecture for future expansion
- Lightweight and optimized performance
- Easy integration with survival and economy servers
- Designed for scalability and long-term support

---

## 🎮 Gameplay Experience

CasinoCore focuses on delivering gameplay that is:

- Easy for new players to understand
- Fast and satisfying to interact with
- Visually clean and modern
- Flexible for different server styles

Every minigame is built around responsive GUI interactions, creating a polished experience without relying on complex commands or confusing mechanics.

---

## ⚙️ System Design

The plugin is structured around a modular and maintainable architecture, allowing features to expand without sacrificing stability or performance.

Core design goals include:

- Clean performance under load
- Simple and scalable configuration
- Consistent user experience
- Easy future expansion
- Seamless server integration

CasinoCore is built to fit naturally into existing Minecraft server ecosystems while remaining developer-friendly for future updates.

---

## 🚀 Planned Features

CasinoCore is actively maintained and continuously improved.

Upcoming updates may include:

- New casino and arcade minigames
- Expanded animation systems
- Additional UI and UX improvements
- More advanced configuration options
- Economy and progression enhancements
- Performance and optimization updates
- API and developer expansion support
